title: The managed agent-instructions block points at itself and never names the guides, search, or the actor flags
description: Routed by opum-agent from its OPAG-378 primer audit (report: opum-agent origin/dev scratchpad/opag-378-primer-audit-2026-09-23.md), measured against quest 0.9.0 and re-measured here. The template in src/application/agents/agent-instructions.ts is regenerated into every fleet repository. (1) It says `quest instructions --json` returns "the current versioned protocol", but that command returns this same block (1,061 content bytes here), so the pointer is circular. (2) It never names `quest instructions --list`, the overview, the four task guides, `quest search`, or `quest help`. (3) It carries the Backlog cutover recipe, which the workspace guide already covers (its "Coming from Backlog.md" section) and every fleet repo has already run. (4) It says writes need an actor declaration without naming --actor, --actor-kind or --accountable-human. Consumer sweep before editing: opum-cli-e2e suites 10/20/22 match on the begin/end markers, the "# Quest agent instructions" heading and content length. The opum-fleet regenerate-quest-block.mjs parses "Quest CLI x.y.z" inside the markers. Local tests pin "This project uses Quest CLI <v> for tracker operations.", the CI exit sentence and "Quest writes require an explicit actor declaration". All of those must survive.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The block no longer describes `quest instructions --json` as the versioned protocol; it names `quest instructions --list` and the overview, task-creation, task-execution, task-finalization and workspace guides with when to read each
The block names `quest search` for finding existing records before creating one, and `quest help <command>`
The Backlog migration recipe is removed from the block and remains reachable through the workspace guide, verified by reading that guide
The block names the actor flags for both a human and a delegated agent: --actor, --actor-kind human|delegated-agent, --accountable-human

The begin/end markers, the heading, the `Quest CLI <version> for tracker operations.` sentence, the CI exit sentence and the phrase `Quest writes require an explicit actor declaration` are preserved, and the version-only check still reports version-only on a block differing only in its version
bun test and the repository check pass; this repo own CLAUDE.md managed block is regenerated in the same PR and `quest agents --check --target claude` exits 0 against the built checkout
